verdict.rationale: Smithery's service tokens can be scoped so an agent can only list and call tools on specific connections, selected by namespace and metadata filters (e.g. `my-app` where `metadata.userId` is `user-123`). Namespace-scoped API keys add workspace-level isolation. Together these give server/connection-level restriction, but nothing shows allowlisting or denying individual tools within a connection. Missing for 10: per-tool allowlists or access control, explicit server allowlist policies, and independent corroboration.
